scope.summary: Implement simulation cache post-editing (CG-26, MD Animation Editor cache ops + layers cut/merge + Scene Time Warp; AREQ-012): trim/cut cached frame ranges, create loop-safe cycles (seam-frame blending for game/adult loops), blend/merge two cached takes, and retime a cache, with loop metadata persisted into animation export lanes per Section 13.10.
acceptance_criteria: Cache ops on per-frame mesh caches (MT-290): cut(range), loop(range, blend_frames) producing seam-blended cycles whose first/last frames match within MeshComparator epsilon, blend(cache_a, cache_b, crossfade_frames), retime(curve).
Loop metadata (cycle range, blend length) persists in GarmentAnimationDraft and rides Alembic-shim/OBJ-seq/VAT/glTF exports where representable (AREQ-012 loop preservation).
Ops are cache-level (no re-simulation), deterministic, and emit animation events; edited caches replay in the viewport scrub (MT-295).
scope.risk_if_missed: Loopable garment/motion cycles are the unit of game and adult animation content; without cache post-editing every loop means re-simulating until the seam accidentally matches.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the Tailor* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.11/13.14.
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long sim/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Reconcile timeline stepping, wind, cache authority, reset/pin/freeze, coupled trim advance, replay, and deterministic animation evidence with accepted checkpoints and tier-specific promotion.
